p1: [tense, quiet] At 2 a.m., my doorbell camera showed my mum. [pause] She lives four hours away.
[softer, fond] Every Sunday she calls me, and always hangs up the same way.
[uneasy] On the camera, she was in her dressing gown. Smiling. [whispers] Not blinking.
[sweetly] It's me, love. Let me in.
[nervous] My hand was on the lock when my phone buzzed. A text from Mum.
[sleepy, gentle] Can't sleep, love. Talk on Sunday?
[shaky] I said... you're not my mum.
[whispers, menacing] If you won't open the door for her... let's see if she'll open it for you.
[scared] Then it walked off. Toward the highway.
[quietly, voice breaking] That was four hours ago.
[calm, unsettling] Someone's at my door, love. It sounds just like you.
[panicked, desperate] She's not answering. Lock the door, Mum!
[shaky, determined] I'm driving there now. Follow for what I find.
